Le volume suit la recommandation UIT-R B: Loudness follows the ITU-R BS.1770 recommendation, like the loudness tool. Frequencies are measured over the whole track, in third-octaves, after matching the loudness of both tracks; the stereo compares the middle and the sides of the sound.
Médiums en avant : son nasal ou « téléph: Forward mids: nasal or “telephone” sound if they stick out too much.
Médiums en retrait : voix et instruments: Recessed mids: vocals and instruments less present, the mix sounds distant.
Mix plus creux que la référence dans le: Mix hollower than the reference in the low mids: it may lack warmth.

Moins de présence : la voix risque de ma: Less presence: the vocal may lack clarity and intelligibility.
Moins de sub : la référence descend plus: Less sub: the reference goes lower. A bit of 40–60 Hz on the kick or the bass adds weight.
